entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: ?Court No. - 85
Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 13070 of 2022

Applicant :- Anoop Goyal
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P And Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Jai Raj,Mrityunjay Singh

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mrs. Jyotsna Sharma,J.
01.

Heard Sri Jai Raj, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri O.P. Mishra, learned Aga for the State
and perused the papers on record.

02.  The present application has been moved seeking anticipatory bail in Complaint Case.2429 of 2015, (Anoop Goyal vs. Ram Autar Singh) under Sections 323, 504, 506 and 420 I.P.C., P.S.
Khandauli, District Agra.
03.

entities.text: Anoop Goyal vs. Ram Autar Singh)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The applicant has been summoned under Sections 323, 504, 506 and 420 I.P.C. on complaint filed by complainant that he was duped of money on false pretext of executing a sale deed.
When the complainant protested he was physically assaulted.
04. It is contended on behalf of the applicant that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in this case.

05. The anticipatory bail application is opposed by the learned A.G.A. pointing out that in this case the applicant has been summoned in the year 2016 and since then he has not appeared before the court concerned.

It is pointed out that the application for anticipatory bail moved before the session court was in fact dismissed inter alia for reasons that process under Section 82 Cr.P.C. as well as N.B.W. were running against him.
It is argued that in view of the above facts, he does not deserve to be granted anticipatory bail.

06. It may also be kept in mind that anticipatory bail is an extraordinary remedy to be exercised in Anoop Goyal vs State Of U.P And Another on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/63016067/
1 suitable cases only.

entities.text: Anoop Goyal vs State Of U.P And Another on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The powers under Section 438 Cr.P.C. cannot be utilized in a routine manner and definitely not as a substitute for regular bail.

This discretionary power calls for existence of facts of the kind where the court is satisfied that its interference is necessary to further the cause of justice and to prevent misuse of process of law.
07. In view of the facts and circumstances of the case I do not find it fit case to grant benefit of anticipatory bail.
08. Hence the anticipatory bail application is rejected.

09. It is made clear that observations made in rejecting anticipatory bail to the applicant shall not in any way affect the learned trial Judge in forming his independent opinion at any stage of the case based on material before him Order Date :- 21.2.2023/Asha  Anoop Goyal vs State Of U.P And Another on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/63016067/
